name: Moon
map_label: Selenographic coordinates, mean Earth / polar axis frame
blurb: The only other world humans have walked on. Six Apollo landing sites and a scatter of robotic precursors sit within about 30° of the equator on the near side.
context: Coordinates are selenographic latitude and longitude in the mean Earth/polar-axis frame used by the NASA NSSDC landings table and the LROC survey of anthropogenic features.

name: Mars
blurb: Nine landed missions in this archive, spread across more than 200° of longitude — from Chryse Planitia to Gusev crater to Elysium.
context: Coordinates are planetocentric areographic latitude and east longitude, as published by the mission sources for each site.
